steps_password-generator_1Desc: Choose password length and character types — uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. Longer passwords with all character types provide maximum security.
steps_password-generator_2Desc: Click Generate to create a cryptographically random password using your browser's secure random number generator. Each generation is completely independent.
steps_password-generator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the password. Paste it directly into a password manager — never store passwords in plain text files or email them to yourself.
